ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity white pixels are restricted to small, discrete peripheral clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment across the main body of the fluke; discrete high-contrast white pixel clusters located primarily on the leading edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along both lobes; a significant macro-scale indentation/notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from distal tips toward the median notch; the left lobe tapers to a sharp point while the right lobe shows a more rounded distal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (circular) concentrated along the leading edges of both lobes and at the distal tips; several smaller clusters scattered on the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely dense cluster of high-contrast, raised objects (barnacles) extending beyond the edge profile on the tip of the left lobe.
